Perfect -ing Forms to Express Results

You use the Perfect -ing form to talk about results and time. Using this structure gives your language a more dynamic quality. Varying your language use is important in professional contexts when you want to sound interesting.

Having heard his speech, I decided to join the company.
Having forgotten my computer at home, I had to use the one at the library.
We signed up for the conference having realized the presenter was the previous CEO.
I don't recall having signed off on that.
Having said all this, I think you get my point.
I don't remember having specified how many.
Adam, having written that letter was good, but you have to be more diligent with your work.
I forgot having explained that to you.
There are various ways to express purpose in English. You can use so that or in order to, so as to and for; sometimes you can simply use the infinitive of purpose.
You use so that to say that one person does something and as a result someone else can do or doesn't have to do something else. You use it to connect the two clauses.
She drove me to work so that I didn't have to walk in the rain.
You can use in order to or so as to in more formal contexts, such as in the workplace or in writing.

She drove to work in order not to have to walk in the rain.
She drove to work so as not to have to walk in the rain.
For is very formal and should only be used in rare cases.
I am going to expect a lot more out of you for these reasons.
Well, I thought I could go there in order to make some contacts.

Interview your friends and family about the idea of starting over in life.

Ask them the following questions (and add more of your own if you wish):
  • What are some situations when people have had to start over in life?
  • How would you feel if you had to start over?
  • What factors might make starting over a challenge? What would make it easier?
  • Why might some people refuse to start over?
  • Why might some people welcome a fresh start or chance to begin again?
Talk about your ideas as well.
Take notes on what they say if that will help you to remember.
Discuss what you found out in class groups.
Share your own opinion as well.

contents.content: Instructions: Complete the following steps. Fill in the Self-Assessment.

images.text:
Denise: Adam, I got your request letter this morning and I have a few questions for you so as to clear up any misunderstandings we may have.
Adam: Ok.
Denise: A request for a funding letter is necessary so that our employees don't go overboard with their requests and in order to help the company stay on budget.
Adam: Right.
Denise: How many people are going on this business excursion?
Adam: Oh. I don't remember having specified how many.
Denise: Yeah, I would like to have sent at least two.
Adam: I can change that.

Denise: So, you are charging us an $800.00 return? Are you flying business class both ways?
Adam: Ugh! Well, actually I would have liked to have flown first class, but ... I don't need to. That was a joke.
Denise: Yeah. I don't recall having signed off on that.
Denise: Also, you are asking for $250 additional so that you can go to a dinner event and see some inspirational speakers?
Adam: Oh. I forgot having written that. Well, I thought I could go there in order to make some contacts. Before I come back, I want to have met as many people as possible.
Denise: Yeah. Well I would like to have lived in the 17th century, but that's not going to happen either. Having said this, I think you get the hint. The request letter needs modifying.

Adam: Um, so the trip didn't receive funding?
Denise: No, the trip is a go. I took your letter and modified it this morning, myself.
Adam: Oh. I guess. I won't be going?
Denise: Adam. You get to go, but you are going to be assisting Boris. Whatever he needs you will do and do it quickly. Also, I want to have received a new request for funding letter from you by the end of the day.
Adam: Ok.
Denise: Adam, having written that letter was good, but you have to be more diligent with your work. You have some good ideas and good instincts, so from now on, I am going to expect a lot more out of you for these reasons.
Adam: I won't let you down.
